headings.usage: H1, H2, H3, large expressive numbers and editorial quotes. MUST import from Google Fonts. Perfect for the Vietnamese fantasy/wuxia aesthetic.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, reading text, tags. (Supports Vietnamese).

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F0F11]/60 border-b border-white/10. Use for the sticky navigation and reading chapter toolbars.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use an SVG noise/grain overlay (mix-blend-overlay, opacity-20, pointer-events-none) across the entire site to remove digital flatness and give a cinematic film grain feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep, diffused glow rather than hard drop shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(212,175,55,0.1)] for glowing books or top-ranking cards.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px delicate inner stroke is MANDATORY on glass elements to separate it from the background (border-white/10).

grids: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for Story Categories and Home page highlights. Never fill the grid symmetrically. Use gap-8 or gap-12.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height. Background is a React Three Fiber canvas with slowly floating 3D particles/dust. Foreground is a kinetic masked Framer Motion text reveal of the story title.
layouts.story_cards: Use Framer Motion to apply 3D tilt (rotateX, rotateY) based on mouse position. Overlay dark gradients (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/40 to-transparent) to ensure text legibility.
layouts.reader_interface: Distraction-free. Use 'react-pageflip' for realistic 3D book page turning. Toolbars should be Crystal Glassmorphism and should auto-hide on scroll.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Do not cram elements together.

motion.scroll: MUST use 'lenis' for momentum smooth scrolling. Parallax effects on large images.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion AnimatePresence fade and subtle scale.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states must lift the element (-translate-y-1) and increase the shadow/glow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has a background overlay to maintain APCA readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='read-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Run: yarn add @react-three/fiber @react-three/drei three framer-motion lenis @phosphor-icons/react react-pageflip clsx tailwind-merge
Import 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in index.css. Setup Tailwind config to use them. Make sure to define colors accurately.
Implement a persistent smooth scrolling context using Lenis at the root app level.
For the Hero section, use a Canvas from @react-three/fiber. Add <Stars> or a custom particle system for the '3D floating objects' background effect.
Implement the story cards with Framer Motion. Use onMouseMove to calculate the tilt and apply it via useTransform for a 3D rotate effect on hover.
For the story reader page (trang truyện / reading mode), use react-pageflip for the 3D book turning effect. This fulfills the '3D book page-flip effect when reading' requirement.
The UI must be strictly in Vietnamese. Ensure accurate routing structure (Trang chủ, Thể loại, Top Rankings, Đăng nhập, Hồ sơ, v.v.). Mock the data as requested.
DO NOT use raw HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use custom designed Radix primitives or styled dropdowns.
Use extremely generous padding (e.g., p-12, py-24). Avoid default centered 'SaaS' layouts. Make it look like a high-end cinematic universe.
Mock the authentication flows for Login/Register with beautifully designed modal overlays or full-page splits.
Always apply data-testid to interactive elements (e.g. data-testid='genre-filter-button').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds where text is readable over changing images.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always target specific properties like transform and opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
